skill.summary: Optimize conversion pages for paid traffic from Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google Ads, TikTok Ads, YouTube Ads, Amazon Ads, and Shopify Ads journeys.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of landing-page-optimizer skill focused on optimizing ad landing pages for major platforms: Meta, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, YouTube Ads, Amazon Ads, and Shopify Ads.
- Introduces structured workflow: objective definition, channel role assignment, budget planning, test matrix setup, and scale/stop rules.
- Requires clear input fields (objective, budget, channel scope) and outputs actionable strategy, budget split, and specific test/scale rules.
- Provides platform-specific guidance and decision rules to ensure recommendations are channel-aware.
- Includes practical examples, quality checklist, and explicit guidelines for failure handling and risk escalation.
